content: Nu̱tyuramusiy rirye̱cha deramiy jijye̱myitya Crístumu, nu̱tyuramusiy
Deramiy, jirya̱ma̱ tuva̱chu ruumu jijye̱myi, Vu̱yntyityu̱mu, jiryatiy vase vichasara daryaju̱ darya.
Darya su̱teda Ju̱denu:

content.text: Vurya̱jnu̱y samiy nanuna̱cho̱ vuryi̱no̱da, vu̱jye̱ñe̱cho̱ jarye.

content: Sabayada jirya niquejadatara ru̱ventiy, vurya̱tidye datyasarara nu̱tyu ra̱cha rijyu̱ rityi tuva̱chusara ramu.
Su̱teda jadchintyi:

content.text: Vurya̱jnu̱y samiy nanuna̱cho̱ vu̱jye̱jyu̱y, vurya̱tidye jnu̱jeya̱sara samiy ja̱muca̱ jirya mucadimu.

content: Deramiy ja̱myintyi, ne jirya̱nique̱ttaniryi jidyedyeñu, jirya̱ma̱ ja̱vyechu Vu̱yntyityu̱ vasedodamu riy, sadatyadodamuju̱.
Nu̱tyuramusiy rirye̱cha muchechimyi jipyatru̱mitya Crístumu, nu̱tyuramusiy
Cumudemintyi, jirya̱ma̱ tuva̱chu simu jipyatru̱. Jirya̱jvaay jichuvu̱yadamu, jiryemyichutyedamu nta jarye risa̱ju̱, darya ntanuma jiryeñi jvaay taraqui jachipiya̱jadata Crístunijyu̱ variy.
Ne jirya̱jvaay vinu sa̱tidye jachipiya̱ jiryepyatru̱ samiy jvadichavay variy jirye. Daryatiy Crístu cumudemidye jiryeñi̱chantiy, jirya̱ma̱ jvaay jijechityara Ju̱denu va̱tara.
Jirya̱jvaay samiy jachipiya̱jadatara nu̱tyu Vu̱yntyityu̱ju̱, ne nu̱tyu nijya̱mi̱ju̱ day.
Jiryedyetyama̱ daryaju̱ darya: Sa̱jmutya̱ nu̱ñi ti̱quira samiy yivaayada murichirya. Daryani̱ sa̱jmutya̱ Ju̱denumusintyirya, dañuma sani̱cha cumude, varimyatamu̱y ne sani̱cha cumude.
Nu̱tyuramusiy rirye̱cha patru̱miy jimyuchechimyitya Crístumu, nu̱tyuramusiy

Patru̱mintyi, jirya̱ma̱ bachara samiryi jicyumudemiy. Jirya̱ma̱ paru̱y riva ja̱suye̱yada niquejadata riy, jirya̱jachipityaja̱ variñi̱ jiryatiy savichasara ti̱qui Vu̱yntyityu̱ jarichumu, ni̱timyu̱ ne datya javiryu̱tya̱da ti̱.
Ju̱denu siityari̱vay jvatyá̱ ratatiy ru̱vachara riy bayantuveda
Parichemyusiy ji̱ta, ratyeryi̱veda, vurya̱ma̱ vanu̱tya Vu̱yntyityu̱mu vu̱y, jaryi savanu̱yada jmu̱tya̱data.

Vurya̱ma̱ jachu vuryivara Ju̱denumusirya bayantu jatyata̱, vurya̱tidye vanu̱tya bayantu nutyityu̱ quivu̱choda jidcho̱ju̱ vu̱y, jiryatimyu̱ ne vu̱ñique̱chara nijya̱nvay savityavay jiyaro̱ju̱, dantyamu̱y ne nudatavay jiyaro̱ju̱. Vu̱ñique̱chara ji̱ta riyaro̱ju̱ nutyityu̱veda day, nusu̱vyevyeda jarye, rityi nusu̱chara jirya mucadimu nupocudinube, rityi vichasara riicho ja̱nvay, jarichumu vichavay bayantuveda nicyara̱myi.
Ramuni̱day vurya̱jmutya̱ vuryimuju̱ra Ju̱denumusirya bayantu jatyata̱ ti̱ta̱ju̱, vurya̱tidye vanu̱tya paru̱cha̱riy rundamu vu̱y; vu̱ñumatiy vuunu variryi, vurya̱ma̱cho̱sara ca̱na̱vye variy.
Vurya̱ma̱ radesiy nu̱tyu puchusara nta vu̱cyadnumu Ju̱denu niquejadata. Vurya̱jachu vu̱dyutuuvyara vu̱dyutuujyo, jiryatiy Ju̱denumusiy vase vicha̱da darya.
Vurya̱jachu vu̱ñumutuvantirya nu̱tyu saapátuntiy ratatiy vurya̱jdutya samitu̱choda tu̱chunumaya̱jadaju̱ vu̱y.
Jadchiy ji̱ta vurya̱jmutya̱ntirya vu̱ryamityáta̱ntiy jiryatiy vuryi̱tay Ju̱denumu tuva̱choda darya, ratatiy vurya̱jmutya̱ ti̱ta̱ju̱ra bayantu nutyityu̱ ruve, jiryatiy saduu jiidatya vu̱ñe̱cho̱ju̱ra.
Vurya̱jmutya̱ vuryi̱no̱co̱ju̱ra Ju̱denu jmu̱tya̱dantiy, vurya̱jirintyirya Ju̱denu niquejadantiy, jiryatiy Ju̱denu Jnutu jchityitya̱ darya.

Ne vurya̱paru̱y riva Ju̱denujsa̱ tu̱choda, vurya̱jiyasantajaya̱ jachiñu̱yada ni̱, Su̱ntumusiy datyadodamuju̱. Vurya̱ntya vichasara vani̱ravay, vurya̱tidye jdutya tara jidcho̱ju̱ vu̱y, ne vurya̱paru̱tya riva vu̱y. Vurya̱tu̱chujaya̱sara sisa̱ Ju̱denu, ti̱ta̱ju̱ sasiityari̱vajyuu jiyadaju̱.

Jirya̱tu̱chu sisa̱ Ju̱denu rayadaju̱ntidye, ra̱tidye nique vijyo̱mujache ri̱tosirya samitu̱chodantidye, jiryatiy dutyasara ravichanu̱yada, ra̱tidye tu̱chu rachuvu̱yasa̱damura jiryatiy sanique Ju̱denu rimusidyerya.
Ravyicha Ju̱denuju̱ tu̱chu̱ tanuvu̱nujovimu. Ramuni̱ rañiqueru̱y rachuvu̱yasa̱damu, daryatiy sava̱ta ra̱nique jijyu̱.
Samu̱chuveda Pávurubay tamitya riy

Jirya̱tidye datya raynchiy, nu̱tyura rañi̱cha, Tíquicu ra̱tu̱chu jiryivara ti̱ta̱ju̱ ravyicha̱da, rivaayada jarye. Ni̱ni̱ ji̱ta vu̱tyeryi̱ jaryi va̱tasi̱, samiy jmu̱tyara varidyeñi̱, jiryatiy sivaachara samiy Vu̱yntyityu̱mu dárya.
Ri̱pa̱ jiryimuju̱ni̱, sa̱tidye datyatanirya tu̱choda raynchiy, ne jirya̱jachipiya̱ tajijyu̱ jijechimyu variy.
Rirye̱cha samiy vu̱tyeryi̱veda Vu̱jye̱ Ju̱denu va̱ta̱damu, su̱nu̱chodamu jarye jiryatiy su̱nu̱chusara jivya̱ta̱damu Vu̱yntyityu̱ Jesucrístumusidyevyu̱y.
Sa̱sa̱chara samiy vichasa̱da riy ti̱ta̱ju̱ jiryatiy vu̱vya̱tajaya̱sarani̱ Vu̱yntyityu̱ Jesucrístu, ne baryi̱jasara va̱ta̱damuju̱. Sayanuma Pávuru
